appearances.title: Axion 1.0 open agent models hit 59% HLE with a two-SFT-plus-RL recipe and full training code
appearances.summary: ByteDance's Axion 1.0 is an open agent foundation model trained with two supervised stages plus reinforcement learning, and without mid-training, DPO or on-policy distillation. The 122B MoE model scores 59.0% on Humanity's Last Exam, with a 35B sibling at 52.2%, and the authors release the paper, training code, data pipeline and a 35B checkpoint.
